order_by_mat_lvl <- function(dt){
  
  dtMAT_SEQ <- data.table(
    MAT_SEQ = names(MATHIER),
    MAT_LVL = MATHIER 
  ) %>% setorder(MAT_SEQ)
  
  dtMAT_SEQ[dt, on = .(MAT_LVL)] %T>%
    setorder(MAT_SEQ)             %>%
    .[, !"MAT_SEQ"]
}

order_by_cst_lvl <- function(dt){
  
  dtCST_SEQ <- data.table(
    CST_SEQ = names(CSTHIER),
    CST_LVL = CSTHIER

  dt %T>%

get_md_material <- function(){
  
  # Read the data BW report in xlsx into a data.table
  message("Getting material master data...")  
  dtRET   <- wb_read(
    file            = ET2BB,
    sheet           = "MAT_ALL",
    start_row       = 19,
    start_col       = 6,
    skip_empty_cols = TRUE,
    skip_empty_rows = TRUE
  )                                             %T>%
    setDT()                                     %T>%
    
    # rename columns
    setnames(
      c(1, 3, 5, 7, 9), 
      MATHIER
    )                                            %>%
    
    # select the relevant columns in order
    .[, MATHIER, with = FALSE]                  %T>%
    setcolorder(MATHIER[2:5], "MATERIAL")        %>%
    
    # Add leading zeros to MATERIAL
    .[, MATERIAL := pa_matn1_input(MATERIAL)] 
  
  return(dtRET)
}

get_md_customer <- function(){
  
  message("Getting customer master data...")
  dtRET    <- wb_read(
    file            = ET2BB,
    sheet           = "CUST_ALL",
    start_row       = 19,
    start_col       = 6,
    skip_empty_cols = TRUE,
    skip_empty_rows = TRUE
  )                                             %T>%
    setDT()                                     %T>%
    setnames(
      c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8), 
      c("SALESORG", "CUSTOMER", CSTHIER[1:3], 
        "PAYER", "SHIPTO", "SOLDTO")
    )                                            %>%
    
    # select the relevant columns
    .[, c("SALESORG", CSTHIER), with = FALSE]   %T>%
    
    # Add leading zeros to CUSTOMER
    .[, CUSTOMER := str_pad(trimws(
      CUSTOMER), 10, "left", pad = "0")] 
  
  return(dtRET)
}

get_sales_per_month <- function(dt){
  
  # get master data
  dtMAT <-   get_md_material() %>% .[BRAND != '#']
  dtCST <-   get_md_customer()
  
  # aggregate sales per month
  dtRET <- dt                                                       %>%
    
    # Add Calendar Year Month as 1st day of the Month
    .[, CM:= floor_date(CALDAY, unit = "months")]                   %>%
    .[, CY:= year(CALDAY)]                                         %T>%
    
    {message("Aggregating to sales per month..."); .}               %>%
    # Add Orders and Free of Charge and aggregate to Cal Month
    .[, .(Q = sum(SLS_QT_SO + SLS_QT_FOC)), 
      by = .(MATERIAL, CUSTOMER, PLANT, SALESORG, CM)]             %T>%
    
    {message("Adding leading zeros..."); .}                         %>%
    # Add leading zeros
    .[, `:=` (
      MATERIAL = pa_matn1_input(MATERIAL),
      CUSTOMER = str_pad(CUSTOMER, 10, "left", pad = "0")
    )]                                                             %T>%
    
    {message("Joining master data..."); .}                          %>%
    # Join with master data
    dtMAT[., on = .(MATERIAL)]                                      %>%
    dtCST[., on = .(CUSTOMER, SALESORG)]                            %>%
    
    # Remove rows with missing or invalid data
    .[!(is.na(BRAND)   | BRAND   == '#')]                           %>%    
    .[!(is.na(CHANNEL) | CHANNEL == '#')]                           %>%
    
    # Remove rows with zero sales
    .[Q > 0 ]                                                      %T>%
    
    # set key for performance
    setkey(MATERIAL, CUSTOMER, PLANT, SALESORG)
  
  return(dtRET)
}

aggregate_mc_combinations_flexible

Code 
aggregate_mc_combinations_flexible <- function(
    dt, 
    agg_function = sum, 
    value_col    = "Q",
    m_cols       = paste0("M", 0:4),
    c_cols       = paste0("C", 0:4)
) {

  message("Creating Matrix with aggregated time series for M-C combinations...")
  
  # Validate inputs
  if (!value_col %in% names(dt)) {
    stop(paste("Column", value_col, "must exist in the data.table"))
  }
  
  # Check if all required columns exist
  missing_m <- m_cols[!m_cols %in% names(dt)]
  missing_c <- c_cols[!c_cols %in% names(dt)]
  
  if (length(missing_m) > 0) {
    warning(paste("Missing M columns:", paste(missing_m, collapse = ", ")))
    m_cols <- m_cols[m_cols %in% names(dt)]
  }
  
  if (length(missing_c) > 0) {
    warning(paste("Missing C columns:", paste(missing_c, collapse = ", ")))
    c_cols <- c_cols[c_cols %in% names(dt)]
  }
  
  if (length(m_cols) == 0 || length(c_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No valid M or C columns found in the data.table")
  }
  
  # Create all combinations
  combinations <- 
    expand.grid(M = m_cols, C = c_cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Initialize result list
  result_list <- list()
  
  # Process each combination
  for (i in 1:nrow(combinations)) {
    m_col <- combinations$M[i]
    c_col <- combinations$C[i]
    
    message("Processing combination: ", 
            str_pad(m_col, 8, 'right', ' '), " - ", c_col)
    # Create the combination name - extract the suffix for cleaner names
    m_suffix <- gsub("^.*_", "", m_col)  # Handle column names like "Material_Type"
    c_suffix <- gsub("^.*_", "", c_col)  # Handle column names like "Customer_Type"
    
    # If columns follow M0, M1 pattern, use those, otherwise use full names
    if (grepl("^M[0-9]+$", m_col) && grepl("^C[0-9]+$", c_col)) {
      combo_name <- paste0(m_col, c_col)
    } else {
      combo_name <- paste0(m_col, "_", c_col)
    }
    
    by_cols <- unname(c(m_col, c_col, 'CM', 'PLANT', 'SALESORG'))
    # Aggregate by the M and C column combination
    agg_table <- 
      dt[, .(aggregated_value = agg_function(get(value_col), na.rm = TRUE)), 
                    by = by_cols]
    
    # Rename columns for clarity
    setnames(
      agg_table, 
      c(m_col, c_col, "aggregated_value"), 
      c("M_value", "C_value", value_col)
    )
    
    # Add metadata columns
    agg_table[, M_column    := m_col]
    agg_table[, C_column    := c_col]
    agg_table[, combination := combo_name]
    
    # Reorder columns for better readability
    setcolorder(
      agg_table, 
      c("combination", "M_column", "C_column", "M_value", "C_value", value_col)
    )
    
    # Store in result list
    result_list[[combo_name]] <- agg_table
  }
  
  return(result_list)
}

Classify Time Series

Functions

calc_ABC

Code 
calc_ABC <- function(
    dt, 
    agg_lvl, 
    thresholds = c(A = 0.8, B = 0.95), 
    value_col  = "Q") {
  
  # message("Calculating ABC classification for aggregation level: ", 
  #         paste(agg_lvl, collapse = ", "))
  # Create a copy to avoid modifying original
  temp_dt <- copy(dt)
  
  # Create aggregation
  agg_dt <- temp_dt[, .(Q_total = sum(get(value_col), na.rm = TRUE)), by = agg_lvl]
  
  # Calculate ABC classification
  setorder(agg_dt, -Q_total)
  agg_dt[, cum_pct := cumsum(Q_total) / sum(Q_total)]
  agg_dt[, ABC_class := fcase(
    cum_pct <= thresholds["A"], "A",
    cum_pct <= thresholds["B"], "B",
    default = "C"
  )]
  
  # Add row indices to preserve order
  temp_dt[, orig_order := .I]
  
  # Merge classification back
  result_dt <- merge(temp_dt, agg_dt[, c(agg_lvl, "ABC_class"), with = FALSE], 
                     by = agg_lvl, all.x = TRUE)
  
  # Restore original order and return classification
  setorder(result_dt, orig_order)
  return(result_dt$ABC_class)
}

create_ts_classifications

Code 
create_ts_classifications <- 
  function(dt, MAT_LEVEL = NULL, CUST_LEVEL = NULL){
    
    # Set defaults from dt if parameters are NULL
    if (is.null(MAT_LEVEL)) {
      MAT_LEVEL <- 'M_value'
    }
    
    if (is.null(CUST_LEVEL)) {
      CUST_LEVEL <- 'C_value'
    }
    
    # Validate that the columns exist
    if (!MAT_LEVEL %in% names(dt)) {
      stop(paste("Column", MAT_LEVEL, "not found in data.table"))
    }
    
    if (!CUST_LEVEL %in% names(dt)) {
      stop(paste("Column", CUST_LEVEL, "not found in data.table"))
    }
    
    # Build the aggregation levels vector outside
    agg_levels <- c(MAT_LEVEL, CUST_LEVEL, "PLANT", "SALESORG")
  
    message(paste0(
      "Classifying time series into Classes: ABC/XYZ/SBC for ",
      paste0(
        str_pad(dt$M_column[1], 8, "right", " "), " - ",
                dt$C_column[1]), "..."
    ) )
    
    dt[Q != 0, {
      # Calculate the range of CM (Calendar Month)
      cm_range <- range(CM)
      
      # Extract year and month from min/max dates
      min_year  <- year( cm_range[1])
      min_month <- month(cm_range[1])
      max_year  <- year( cm_range[2])
      max_month <- month(cm_range[2])
      
      # Calculate month difference: (year_diff * 12) + month_diff
      months_diff <- (max_year - min_year) * 12L + 
        (max_month - min_month)
      
      # calculate statistical values
      stats <- c(
        count = .N,
        sum   = sum( Q),
        mu    = mean(Q),
        sigma = sd(  Q),
        min   = min( Q),
        max   = max( Q)
      )
      
      # Calculate quantiles
      quants <- quantile(Q, c(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95))
      
      .(
        minCM = cm_range[1]   ,
        maxCM = cm_range[2]   ,  
        SLEN  = months_diff   ,
        N     = stats['count'],
        Q     = stats['sum']  ,
        MU    = stats['mu']   ,
        SIGMA = stats['sigma'],
        MIN   = stats['min']  ,
        Q05   = quants[1]     ,
        Q25   = quants[2]     ,
        Q50   = quants[3]     ,
        Q75   = quants[4]     ,
        Q95   = quants[5]     ,
        MAX   = stats['max']
      )
    }, 
    by = agg_levels
    ] %>%
      .[, `:=`(
        ADI = SLEN/N,
        CV  = (
          ifelse(is.na(SIGMA)        , 0, SIGMA)/
            ifelse(is.na(MU)  | MU == 0, 1, MU))
      )] %>%
      .[, CV2 := CV^2]                                                    %>%
      .[, ABC:=  calc_ABC(
        dt         = .,
        agg_lvl    = agg_levels,
        thresholds = c(A = 0.8, B = 0.95),
        value_col  = "Q"
      )]                                                                  %>%
      .[, XYZ := fcase(
        # X: Low      — highly predictable
        CV <  0.5         , "X",
        # Y: Moderate — somewhat predictable    
        CV >= 0.5 & CV < 1, "Y",    
        # Z: High     — unpredictable or lumpy 
        CV >= 1           , "Z",
        default           = "U" # Unclassified
      )]                                                                  %>%
      .[, SBC := fcase(
        ADI <= 1.32 & CV2 <= 0.49, "S",    # Smooth
        ADI <= 1.32 & CV2 >  0.49, "E",    # Erratic  
        ADI >  1.32 & CV2 <= 0.49, "I",    # Intermittent
        ADI >  1.32 & CV2 >  0.49, "L",    # Lumpy
        default                  = "U"     # Unclassified
      )] %>%
      .[, `:=`(
        AGG_LVL = dt$combination[1],
        MAT_LVL = dt$M_column[1],
        CUS_LVL = dt$C_column[1]
      )] %T>%
      setcolorder(
        c("AGG_LVL", "MAT_LVL", "CUS_LVL"), 
        before = "M_value"
      )
  }

calculate_features_stl

calculate_features_stl <- function(dt){
  
  message(paste0(
    "Calculate Seasonal & Trend strength for time series ",
    paste0(
      str_pad(dt$MAT_LVL[1], 8, "right", " "), " - ",
              dt$CUS_LVL[1]), "...")
  ) 
  
  dt                %>%
    .[, CALMONTH:= yearmonth(CM)]               %>%
    # .[ SIGMA > 0 & N > 46 & SLEN > 36 & Q > 10] %>%
    .[, c("SALESORG", "PLANT", 
          "AGG_LVL" , "M_value", "C_value",
          "CALMONTH", "Q"), with = FALSE]       %>%
    as_tsibble(, 
               index = "CALMONTH", 
               key   = c("SALESORG", "PLANT", 
                         "AGG_LVL" , "M_value", "C_value"),
               regular = TRUE
    ) %>% 
    # Fill gaps in time series
    fill_gaps(Q = 0) %>%
    features(Q, ~ feat_stl(
      .x, 
      s.window = "periodic",
      .period  = 12)
    )
}

create_seasonal_trend_strength_facet_plot <- function(dt){
  
  # Define hierarchical order using data.table
  mat_order <- MATHIER[order(names(MATHIER), decreasing = FALSE)]
  cus_order <- CSTHIER[order(names(CSTHIER), decreasing = TRUE)]
  
  # More elegant data.table way using CJ (Cross Join)
  all_combinations <- CJ(
    MAT = mat_order,
    CUS = cus_order,
    sorted = FALSE  # Keep the order we specified
  )[, combination := paste(MAT, CUS, sep = " - ")]  
  
  # Set factor levels
  dt[, combination := factor(
    AGG_LVL, levels = all_combinations$combination)]
  
  # Replace underscores in existing combinations if needed
  dt[, combination := factor(
    gsub("_", " - ", AGG_LVL), 
    levels = gsub("_", " - ", all_combinations$combination)
  )]
  
  # Create the faceted scatter plot
  plot <- 
    ggplot(dt, 
         aes(x = trend_strength, y = seasonal_strength_12)) +
    geom_point(
      fill  = "#38e56d", 
      color = "#38e56d",
      alpha = 0.1,  # Increased from 0.1 for better visibility
      size  = 1.0    # Added size for consistency
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ combination, ncol = 4, nrow = 5) +
    # Force both axes to show 0-1 range
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    # Set consistent tick marks and labels
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),  # Ticks at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.5", "0.75", "1")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),  # Ticks at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.5", "0.75", "1")
    ) +  
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),
      axis.title         = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.text          = element_text(size = 5),  
      strip.text         = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", color = "gray60"),  
      panel.spacing      = unit(0.4, "lines"),  
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),  
      plot.caption       = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = "Time Series Feature Distribution by Material-Customer Hierarchy",
      subtitle = "No notable difference in Trend vs Seasonal Strength",
      x        = "Trend Strength",  
      y        = "Seasonal Strength (12-month)",
      caption  = "distribution of trend vs seasonal strength for different hierarchy combinations"
    )
  
  save_plot(plot, "seasonal_trend_strength_facet_plot" )
  
  return(plot)
}

    ) +

      title    = "Time Series Demand Patterns by Material-Customer Hierarchy",
      subtitle = "Clear Patterns on every hierarchy level",
      x        = "Trend Strength",  
      y        = "Seasonal Strength (12-month)",
      caption  = paste0(
        "Note: time series with the highest seasonal & trend strength \n",
        "are shown per Material-Customer Hierarchy combination"
      )
    )
  
  save_plot(plot, "examples_facet_plot" )
  
  return(plot)

create_plot_sbm <- function(
    dt, 
    adi_bound = 5, 
    cv2_bound = 15){
  
  hidden_count <- nrow(dt[ADI > adi_bound | CV2 > cv2_bound])
  total_count  <- nrow(dt)
  pct_shown    <- round((total_count - hidden_count) / total_count * 100, 1)
  
      
  # Calculate global percentages for subtitle
  summary_dt <- dt[, .(N = .N), by = SBC]                          %>%
    .[, Percentage := round(N / sum(N) * 100, 1)]                 %T>% 
    setorder(-Percentage)                                          %>%
    .[, subtitle:= paste0(SBC, "(", Percentage, "%) ")]                             
    
  # Create subtitle with overall percentages
  subtitle_clean <- paste0(
    "Aggregation level: ", paste(dt$MAT_LVL[1], '-', dt$CUS_LVL[1]), "\n",
    paste(summary_dt$subtitle, collapse = " "  ))
  
  plot <- dt %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = ADI, y = CV2)) +
    # Add background rectangles for each quadrant
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.32, ymin = -Inf, ymax = 0.49, 
             fill = SBC_colors['S'], alpha = 0.1) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.32, ymin = 0.49, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = SBC_colors['E'], alpha = 0.1) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 1.32, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = 0.49, 
             fill = SBC_colors['I'], alpha = 0.1) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 1.32, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0.49, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = SBC_colors['L'], alpha = 0.1) +
    # Add text labels in each quadrant
    annotate("text", x = 0.2, y = 0.25, 
             label = "Smooth (S)", 
             color = SBC_colors['S'], 
             size = 6, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.2, y =3.0, 
             label = "Erratic (E)", 
             color = SBC_colors['E'], 
             size = 6, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 2.6, y = 0.25, 
             label = "Intermittent (I)", 
             color = SBC_colors['I'], 
             size = 6, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 2.6, y = 3.0, 
             label = "Lumpy (L)", 
             color = SBC_colors['L'], 
             size = 6, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = SBC), 
      size     = 2, 
      alpha    = 0.3,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0.05, seed = 123)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1.32, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.49, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = SBC_colors,
      labels = c(
        "S" = "Smooth (S)",
        "E" = "Erratic (E)", 
        "I" = "Intermittent (I)",
        "L" = "Lumpy (L)"
      ),
      guide = guide_legend(
        reverse = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(size = 4)  # Larger points in legend only)
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, adi_bound), ylim = c(0, cv2_bound)) +  # Add this line to zoom  
    labs(
      title    = "Syntetos-Boylan Demand Pattern Classification (Zoomed View)",
      subtitle = subtitle_clean,
      x        = "ADI (Average Demand Interval)",
      y        = "CV² (Coefficient of Variation Squared)",
      color    = "SBC",
      caption  = paste0("Syntetos, A.A. & Boylan, J.E. (2005) | ADI = 1.32, CV² = 0.49 \n",
                        "Zoom: ADI 0-5, CV² 0-15 | Showing ", pct_shown, "% of data points (",
                        total_count - hidden_count, "/", total_count, ")")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),  # Changed from 16 to 14
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),  # Changed from 12 to 10
      axis.title         = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),  # Changed from 12 to 11
      axis.text          = element_text(size = 10),  # Kept same
      legend.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),  # Kept same
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 12),  # Kept same
      legend.key.size    = unit(1.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.width   = unit(2.0, "cm"),
      legend.key.height  = unit(1.0, "cm"),      
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.direction   = "horizontal",
      legend.box         = "horizontal",
      legend.margin      = margin(b = 10),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),  # Added to match reference
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      plot.caption       = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")  # Kept same
    )
  
  save_plot(plot, "plot_sbm" )

create plot sbc_by_ts

Code 
create_plot_sbc_by_ts <- 
  function(dt_plot){
    # Calculate percentages and label positions by SLEN
    dt_plot[, total:= sum(N), by = SLEN]                             %>%
      .[, percentage:= N / total * 100]
    
    # Calculate global percentages for reference lines
    summary_dt <- dt_plot[, .(N = .N), by = SBC]                     %>%
      .[, Percentage := round(N / sum(N) * 100, 1)]                 %T>% 
      setorder(-Percentage)                                          %>%
      .[, subtitle:= paste0(SBC, "(", Percentage, "%) ")]                                     
    
    # Determine the stacking order (smallest to largest average)
    actual_sbc_order <-
      summary_dt[, SBC] 
    
    # Create subtitle with overall percentages
    subtitle_clean <- paste0(
      "Stable distribution, excluding boundary-induced variation \n ",
      paste(summary_dt$subtitle, collapse = " "  ))
    
    # CREATE FACTOR LEVELS to control stacking order
    dt_plot[, SBC := factor(SBC, levels = rev(actual_sbc_order))]
    
    # Sort data by SLEN (no need to sort by percentage anymore - factor levels control stacking)
    dt_plot_ordered <- setorder(dt_plot, SLEN)
    
    # Calculate cumulative percentages in the SAME order
    summary_dt_ordered <- summary_dt[match(actual_sbc_order, SBC)]       %>%
      .[, cum_percentage := cumsum(Percentage)]
    
    # Extract cumulative percentages - only the ones we need (not the 100% line)
    cum_percentages <- summary_dt_ordered$cum_percentage
    cum_classes     <- summary_dt_ordered$SBC
    
    # Define colors for each class
    cum_colors   <- SBC_colors[cum_classes]
    
    ap <- 1.0  # Alpha for dashed lines
    lw <- 1.7  # Line width for dashed lines
    # Create  plot
    plot <- ggplot(
      dt_plot_ordered, 
      aes(
        x    = factor(SLEN), 
        y    = percentage, 
        fill = SBC)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", alpha = 0.7) +
      # Add cumulative dashed horizontal lines manually
      {if(length(cum_percentages) >= 1) 
        geom_hline(yintercept = cum_percentages[1], 
                   color      = cum_colors[1], 
                   linetype   = "dashed", 
                   alpha      = ap, 
                   linewidth  = lw)} +
      {if(length(cum_percentages) >= 2) 
        geom_hline(yintercept = cum_percentages[2], 
                   color      = cum_colors[2], 
                   linetype   = "dashed", 
                   alpha      = ap, 
                   linewidth  = lw)} +
      {if(length(cum_percentages) >= 3) 
        geom_hline(yintercept = cum_percentages[3], 
                   color      = cum_colors[3], 
                   linetype   = "dashed", 
                   alpha      = ap, 
                   linewidth  = lw)} +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = SBC_colors,
        labels = c(
          "S" = "Smooth (S)",
          "E" = "Erratic (E)", 
          "I" = "Intermittent (I)",
          "L" = "Lumpy (L)"
        ),
        guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
      ) +
      labs(
        title    = "% Distribution of SB-Classes by time series length",
        subtitle = subtitle_clean,
        x        = "time series length in months",
        y        = "Percentage (%)",
        fill     = "SBC",
        caption  = paste0(
          "SBC requires > 6 months for to be reliable \n"  , 
          "Dashed lines show cumulative global percentages \n",
          "**Note the large % of smooth time series at the right end (> 46 months)**"
        )
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),
        axis.title         = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        legend.title       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        legend.position    = "bottom",
        legend.direction   = "horizontal",
        legend.box         = "horizontal",
        legend.margin      = margin(b = 10),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
      )
    
    save_plot(plot, "plot_sbc_by_ts" )
    
    return(plot)
  }

create_class_pivot

Code 
# Enhanced flexible function with total_column parameter
create_class_pivot <- function(
    dt, 
    type    = "P",
    X_order = NULL,  # Custom X-axis order
    Y_order = NULL,  # Custom Y-axis order
    V_order = c('S', 'I', 'E', 'L'),
    X = 'XYZ', 
    Y = 'ABC',
    V = 'SBC',
    total_column = NULL  # NEW: Column to use for totals instead of count
)
{
  
  # Validate inputs
  if (!type %in% c("P", "C")) {
    stop("type must be either 'P' (percentage) or 'C' (count)")
  }
  
  required_cols <- c(Y, X, V)
  if (!is.null(total_column)) {
    required_cols <- c(required_cols, total_column)
  }
  
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(dt))) {
    stop(paste("Columns", paste(required_cols, collapse = ", "), "must exist in the data.table"))
  }
  
  # Get unique values and set default orders if not provided
  unique_Y <- unique(dt[[Y]])
  unique_X <- unique(dt[[X]])
  unique_V <- unique(dt[[V]])
  
  # Set default orders if not provided
  if (is.null(Y_order)) {
    Y_order <- sort(unique_Y)
  }
  if (is.null(X_order)) {
    X_order <- sort(unique_X)
  }
  
  # Validate orders
  if (!all(Y_order %in% unique_Y)) {
    missing_Y <- Y_order[!Y_order %in% unique_Y]
    warning(paste("Y_order contains values not in data:", paste(missing_Y, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  if (!all(X_order %in% unique_X)) {
    missing_X <- X_order[!X_order %in% unique_X]
    warning(paste("X_order contains values not in data:", paste(missing_X, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  if (!all(V_order %in% unique_V)) {
    missing_V <- V_order[!V_order %in% unique_V]
    warning(paste("order contains values not in data:", paste(missing_V, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Calculate counts/totals and percentages for each Y-X combination
  if (is.null(total_column)) {
    # Original behavior: use count (.N)
    summary_dt <- dt[, .N, by = c(Y, X, V)]
    setnames(summary_dt, c(Y, X, V), c("Y_col", "X_col", "V_col"))
    summary_dt[, total := sum(N), by = .(Y_col, X_col)]
    summary_dt[, percentage := round(N / total * 100, 1)]
    value_col_name <- "N"
  } else {
    # New behavior: use specified column for totals
    summary_dt <- dt[, .(total_value = sum(get(total_column), na.rm = TRUE)), by = c(Y, X, V)]
    setnames(summary_dt, c(Y, X, V), c("Y_col", "X_col", "V_col"))
    summary_dt[, total := sum(total_value), by = .(Y_col, X_col)]
    summary_dt[, percentage := round(total_value / total * 100, 1)]
    value_col_name <- "total_value"
  }
  
  # Create the compact format based on type
  compact_dt <- summary_dt[, {
    # Ensure all V categories are present, fill missing with 0
    all_values <- data.table(V_col = V_order)
    
    if (type == "P") {
      # Percentage format
      current <- .SD[, .(V_col, value = percentage)]
      merged <- merge(all_values, current, by = "V_col", all.x = TRUE)
      merged[is.na(value), value := 0]
      
      # Fix: Extract the match operation outside the data.table context
      order_indices <- match(merged$V_col, V_order)
      merged <- merged[order(order_indices)]
      
      paste0("(", paste(merged$value, "%", sep = "", collapse = ", "), ")")
      
    } else {
      # Count format - use the appropriate value column
      if (is.null(total_column)) {
        current <- .SD[, .(V_col, value = N)]
      } else {
        current <- .SD[, .(V_col, value = total_value)]
      }
      merged <- merge(all_values, current, by = "V_col", all.x = TRUE)
      merged[is.na(value), value := 0]
      
      # Fix: Extract the match operation outside the data.table context  
      order_indices <- match(merged$V_col, V_order)
      merged <- merged[order(order_indices)]
      
      paste0("(", paste(merged$value, collapse = ", "), ")")
    }
  }, by = .(Y_col, X_col)]
  
  # Reshape to matrix format
  result_table <- dcast(compact_dt, Y_col ~ X_col, value.var = "V1", 
                        fill = if(type == "P") 
                          paste0("(", paste(rep("0%", length(V_order)), collapse = ", "), ")") else 
                            paste0("(", paste(rep("0", length(V_order)), collapse = ", "), ")"))
  
  # Rename columns back to original names
  setnames(result_table, "Y_col", Y)
  
  # Apply custom ordering to Y-axis (rows)
  if (Y %in% names(result_table)) {
    # Create factor with custom order for Y
    result_table[[Y]] <- factor(result_table[[Y]], levels = Y_order)
    setorderv(result_table, Y)
    # Convert back to character to avoid factor display issues
    result_table[[Y]] <- as.character(result_table[[Y]])
  }
  
  # Apply custom ordering to X-axis (columns)
  # Reorder columns based on X_order
  existing_X_cols <- intersect(X_order, names(result_table)[-1])  # Exclude Y column
  final_col_order <- c(Y, existing_X_cols)
  
  # Add any missing columns that might exist but weren't in X_order
  missing_cols <- setdiff(names(result_table), final_col_order)
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    final_col_order <- c(final_col_order, missing_cols)
  }
  
  result_table <- result_table[, ..final_col_order]
  
  return(result_table)
}

summarize_sbc

Code 
# Simple summary function for SBC percentages
summarize_sbc <- function(
    dt, 
    order        = c('S', 'I', 'E', 'L'), 
    total_column = NULL
) {
  
  # Validate input
  if (!"SBC" %in% names(dt)) {
    stop("Column 'SBC' must exist in the data.table")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(total_column) && !total_column %in% names(dt)) {
    stop(paste("Column", total_column, "must exist in the data.table"))
  }
  
  # Calculate percentages
  if (is.null(total_column)) {
    # Count-based percentages
    summary_dt <- dt[, .N, by = SBC]
    summary_dt[, percentage := round(N / sum(N) * 100, 0)]
  } else {
    # Value-based percentages using total_column
    summary_dt <- dt[, .(total_value = sum(get(total_column), na.rm = TRUE)), by = SBC]
    summary_dt[, percentage := round(total_value / sum(total_value) * 100, 0)]
  }
  
  # Ensure all SBC categories are present
  all_sbc <- data.table(SBC = order)
  merged <- merge(all_sbc, summary_dt, by = "SBC", all.x = TRUE)
  merged[is.na(percentage), percentage := 0]
  
  # Order according to specified order
  order_indices <- match(merged$SBC, order)
  merged <- merged[order(order_indices)]
  
  # Create output string
  result <- data.table(
    AGG_LVL = dt$AGG_LVL[1],
    MAT_LVL = dt$MAT_LVL[1],
    CUS_LVL = dt$CUS_LVL[1],
    SBCSIEL = paste0(
      "(", paste(merged$percentage, "%", sep = "", 
                 collapse = ", "), ")"
    )
  )
  
  return(result)
}

  )

  use.names = TRUE,

) %T>%

#4. Join and filter time series with classification data
target_names <- intersect(names(lstCLS), names(lstSLS))

if(flgCache == TRUE){
  lstSCP <- readRDS(file.path(PDATA, "lstSCP.rds"))
} else {
  lstSCP <- imap(
    lstCLS[target_names],  # Subset to only the names you want
    function(cls_data, name) {
      # Explicit selection by name
      sls_data <- lstSLS[[name]]
      
      # Safety check
      if (is.null(sls_data)) {
        stop(paste("No matching sales data found for:", name))
      }
      
      message(paste0(
        "Joining time series >= 12 months with classification data for ",
        paste0(
          str_pad(cls_data$MAT_LVL[1], 8, "right", " "), " - ",
          str_pad(cls_data$CUS_LVL[1], 8, "right", " ")), "..."
      ))
      
      result <- 
        cls_data[SLEN >= 12, !"Q"] %>%
        .[sls_data, on = .(
          M_value, C_value, 
          PLANT, SALESORG), nomatch = 0]
      
      return(result)
    }
  )
}

# Purpose


Refresh data sets for the Pythia project from BW OpenHub to Pythia on OneDrive
ET.

::: callout-note
This notebook applies literate programming to ensure reproducibility and automatic tracking of data changes. Each time the notebook is executed, it analyzes the most current version of the data.

This approach aligns with the principles of reproducible research, a foundational value of the Pythia’s Advice project.
:::


```{r}
#| label: setup
#| eval: true
```

```{r}
order_by_mat_lvl <- function(dt){

    MAT_SEQ = names(MATHIER),
    MAT_LVL = MATHIER 
  ) %>% setorder(MAT_SEQ)
  
  dtMAT_SEQ[dt, on = .(MAT_LVL)] %T>%

    .[, !"MAT_SEQ"]
}
```

#### get_md_material
```{r}
get_md_material <- function(){
  
  # Read the data BW report in xlsx into a data.table
  message("Getting material master data...")  
  dtRET   <- wb_read(
    file            = ET2BB,
    sheet           = "MAT_ALL",
    start_row       = 19,
    start_col       = 6,
    skip_empty_cols = TRUE,
    skip_empty_rows = TRUE
  )                                             %T>%
    setDT()                                     %T>%
    
    # rename columns
    setnames(
      c(1, 3, 5, 7, 9), 
      MATHIER
    )                                            %>%
    
    # select the relevant columns in order
    .[, MATHIER, with = FALSE]                  %T>%
    setcolorder(MATHIER[2:5], "MATERIAL")        %>%
    
    # Add leading zeros to MATERIAL
    .[, MATERIAL := pa_matn1_input(MATERIAL)] 
  
  return(dtRET)
}
```

```{r}
get_md_customer <- function(){

    start_col       = 6,

  return(dtRET)
}
```

#### get_sales_per_month
```{r}
get_sales_per_month <- function(dt){
  
  # get master data
  dtMAT <-   get_md_material() %>% .[BRAND != '#']
  dtCST <-   get_md_customer()
  
  # aggregate sales per month
  dtRET <- dt                                                       %>%
    
    # Add Calendar Year Month as 1st day of the Month
    .[, CM:= floor_date(CALDAY, unit = "months")]                   %>%
    .[, CY:= year(CALDAY)]                                         %T>%
    
    {message("Aggregating to sales per month..."); .}               %>%
    # Add Orders and Free of Charge and aggregate to Cal Month
    .[, .(Q = sum(SLS_QT_SO + SLS_QT_FOC)), 
      by = .(MATERIAL, CUSTOMER, PLANT, SALESORG, CM)]             %T>%
    
    {message("Adding leading zeros..."); .}                         %>%
    # Add leading zeros
    .[, `:=` (
      MATERIAL = pa_matn1_input(MATERIAL),
      CUSTOMER = str_pad(CUSTOMER, 10, "left", pad = "0")
    )]                                                             %T>%
    
    {message("Joining master data..."); .}                          %>%
    # Join with master data
    dtMAT[., on = .(MATERIAL)]                                      %>%
    dtCST[., on = .(CUSTOMER, SALESORG)]                            %>%
    
    # Remove rows with missing or invalid data
    .[!(is.na(BRAND)   | BRAND   == '#')]                           %>%    
    .[!(is.na(CHANNEL) | CHANNEL == '#')]                           %>%
    
    # Remove rows with zero sales
    .[Q > 0 ]                                                      %T>%
    
    # set key for performance
    setkey(MATERIAL, CUSTOMER, PLANT, SALESORG)
  
  return(dtRET)
}
```

#### aggregate_mc_combinations_flexible

```{r}
#| label: 'Create result for Matrix'

aggregate_mc_combinations_flexible <- function(
    dt, 
    agg_function = sum, 
    value_col    = "Q",
    m_cols       = paste0("M", 0:4),
    c_cols       = paste0("C", 0:4)
) {

  message("Creating Matrix with aggregated time series for M-C combinations...")
  
  # Validate inputs
  if (!value_col %in% names(dt)) {
    stop(paste("Column", value_col, "must exist in the data.table"))
  }
  
  # Check if all required columns exist
  missing_m <- m_cols[!m_cols %in% names(dt)]
  missing_c <- c_cols[!c_cols %in% names(dt)]
  
  if (length(missing_m) > 0) {
    warning(paste("Missing M columns:", paste(missing_m, collapse = ", ")))
    m_cols <- m_cols[m_cols %in% names(dt)]
  }
  
  if (length(missing_c) > 0) {
    warning(paste("Missing C columns:", paste(missing_c, collapse = ", ")))
    c_cols <- c_cols[c_cols %in% names(dt)]
  }
  
  if (length(m_cols) == 0 || length(c_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No valid M or C columns found in the data.table")
  }
  
  # Create all combinations
  combinations <- 
    expand.grid(M = m_cols, C = c_cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Initialize result list
  result_list <- list()
  
  # Process each combination
  for (i in 1:nrow(combinations)) {
    m_col <- combinations$M[i]
    c_col <- combinations$C[i]
    
    message("Processing combination: ", 
            str_pad(m_col, 8, 'right', ' '), " - ", c_col)
    # Create the combination name - extract the suffix for cleaner names
    m_suffix <- gsub("^.*_", "", m_col)  # Handle column names like "Material_Type"
    c_suffix <- gsub("^.*_", "", c_col)  # Handle column names like "Customer_Type"
    
    # If columns follow M0, M1 pattern, use those, otherwise use full names
    if (grepl("^M[0-9]+$", m_col) && grepl("^C[0-9]+$", c_col)) {
      combo_name <- paste0(m_col, c_col)
    } else {
      combo_name <- paste0(m_col, "_", c_col)
    }
    
    by_cols <- unname(c(m_col, c_col, 'CM', 'PLANT', 'SALESORG'))
    # Aggregate by the M and C column combination
    agg_table <- 
      dt[, .(aggregated_value = agg_function(get(value_col), na.rm = TRUE)), 
                    by = by_cols]
    
    # Rename columns for clarity
    setnames(
      agg_table, 
      c(m_col, c_col, "aggregated_value"), 
      c("M_value", "C_value", value_col)
    )
    
    # Add metadata columns
    agg_table[, M_column    := m_col]
    agg_table[, C_column    := c_col]
    agg_table[, combination := combo_name]
    
    # Reorder columns for better readability
    setcolorder(
      agg_table, 
      c("combination", "M_column", "C_column", "M_value", "C_value", value_col)
    )
    
    # Store in result list
    result_list[[combo_name]] <- agg_table
  }
  
  return(result_list)
}

``` 

## Classify Time Series

### Functions

#### calc_ABC

```{r}
#| label: 'Create ABC function'


calc_ABC <- function(
    dt, 
    agg_lvl, 
    thresholds = c(A = 0.8, B = 0.95), 
    value_col  = "Q") {
  
  # message("Calculating ABC classification for aggregation level: ", 
  #         paste(agg_lvl, collapse = ", "))
  # Create a copy to avoid modifying original
  temp_dt <- copy(dt)
  
  # Create aggregation
  agg_dt <- temp_dt[, .(Q_total = sum(get(value_col), na.rm = TRUE)), by = agg_lvl]
  
  # Calculate ABC classification
  setorder(agg_dt, -Q_total)
  agg_dt[, cum_pct := cumsum(Q_total) / sum(Q_total)]
  agg_dt[, ABC_class := fcase(
    cum_pct <= thresholds["A"], "A",
    cum_pct <= thresholds["B"], "B",
    default = "C"
  )]
  
  # Add row indices to preserve order
  temp_dt[, orig_order := .I]
  
  # Merge classification back
  result_dt <- merge(temp_dt, agg_dt[, c(agg_lvl, "ABC_class"), with = FALSE], 
                     by = agg_lvl, all.x = TRUE)
  
  # Restore original order and return classification
  setorder(result_dt, orig_order)
  return(result_dt$ABC_class)
}
```
#### create_ts_classifications
```{r}
#| label: Classify time series (3 min)
#| 

create_ts_classifications <- 
  function(dt, MAT_LEVEL = NULL, CUST_LEVEL = NULL){
    
    # Set defaults from dt if parameters are NULL
    if (is.null(MAT_LEVEL)) {
      MAT_LEVEL <- 'M_value'
    }
    
    if (is.null(CUST_LEVEL)) {
      CUST_LEVEL <- 'C_value'
    }
    
    # Validate that the columns exist
    if (!MAT_LEVEL %in% names(dt)) {
      stop(paste("Column", MAT_LEVEL, "not found in data.table"))
    }
    
    if (!CUST_LEVEL %in% names(dt)) {
      stop(paste("Column", CUST_LEVEL, "not found in data.table"))
    }
    
    # Build the aggregation levels vector outside
    agg_levels <- c(MAT_LEVEL, CUST_LEVEL, "PLANT", "SALESORG")
  
    message(paste0(
      "Classifying time series into Classes: ABC/XYZ/SBC for ",
      paste0(
        str_pad(dt$M_column[1], 8, "right", " "), " - ",
                dt$C_column[1]), "..."
    ) )
    
    dt[Q != 0, {
      # Calculate the range of CM (Calendar Month)
      cm_range <- range(CM)
      
      # Extract year and month from min/max dates
      min_year  <- year( cm_range[1])
      min_month <- month(cm_range[1])
      max_year  <- year( cm_range[2])
      max_month <- month(cm_range[2])
      
      # Calculate month difference: (year_diff * 12) + month_diff
      months_diff <- (max_year - min_year) * 12L + 
        (max_month - min_month)
      
      # calculate statistical values
      stats <- c(
        count = .N,
        sum   = sum( Q),
        mu    = mean(Q),
        sigma = sd(  Q),
        min   = min( Q),
        max   = max( Q)
      )
      
      # Calculate quantiles
      quants <- quantile(Q, c(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95))
      
      .(
        minCM = cm_range[1]   ,
        maxCM = cm_range[2]   ,  
        SLEN  = months_diff   ,
        N     = stats['count'],
        Q     = stats['sum']  ,
        MU    = stats['mu']   ,
        SIGMA = stats['sigma'],
        MIN   = stats['min']  ,
        Q05   = quants[1]     ,
        Q25   = quants[2]     ,
        Q50   = quants[3]     ,
        Q75   = quants[4]     ,
        Q95   = quants[5]     ,
        MAX   = stats['max']
      )
    }, 
    by = agg_levels
    ] %>%
      .[, `:=`(
        ADI = SLEN/N,
        CV  = (
          ifelse(is.na(SIGMA)        , 0, SIGMA)/
            ifelse(is.na(MU)  | MU == 0, 1, MU))
      )] %>%
      .[, CV2 := CV^2]                                                    %>%
      .[, ABC:=  calc_ABC(
        dt         = .,
        agg_lvl    = agg_levels,
        thresholds = c(A = 0.8, B = 0.95),
        value_col  = "Q"
      )]                                                                  %>%
      .[, XYZ := fcase(
        # X: Low      — highly predictable
        CV <  0.5         , "X",
        # Y: Moderate — somewhat predictable    
        CV >= 0.5 & CV < 1, "Y",    
        # Z: High     — unpredictable or lumpy 
        CV >= 1           , "Z",
        default           = "U" # Unclassified
      )]                                                                  %>%
      .[, SBC := fcase(
        ADI <= 1.32 & CV2 <= 0.49, "S",    # Smooth
        ADI <= 1.32 & CV2 >  0.49, "E",    # Erratic  
        ADI >  1.32 & CV2 <= 0.49, "I",    # Intermittent
        ADI >  1.32 & CV2 >  0.49, "L",    # Lumpy
        default                  = "U"     # Unclassified
      )] %>%
      .[, `:=`(
        AGG_LVL = dt$combination[1],
        MAT_LVL = dt$M_column[1],
        CUS_LVL = dt$C_column[1]
      )] %T>%
      setcolorder(
        c("AGG_LVL", "MAT_LVL", "CUS_LVL"), 
        before = "M_value"
      )
  }
```
#### calculate_features_stl
```{r}
#| label: calculate features stl

calculate_features_stl <- function(dt){
  
  message(paste0(
    "Calculate Seasonal & Trend strength for time series ",
    paste0(
      str_pad(dt$MAT_LVL[1], 8, "right", " "), " - ",
              dt$CUS_LVL[1]), "...")
  ) 
  
  dt                %>%
    .[, CALMONTH:= yearmonth(CM)]               %>%
    # .[ SIGMA > 0 & N > 46 & SLEN > 36 & Q > 10] %>%
    .[, c("SALESORG", "PLANT", 
          "AGG_LVL" , "M_value", "C_value",
          "CALMONTH", "Q"), with = FALSE]       %>%
    as_tsibble(, 
               index = "CALMONTH", 
               key   = c("SALESORG", "PLANT", 
                         "AGG_LVL" , "M_value", "C_value"),
               regular = TRUE
    ) %>% 
    # Fill gaps in time series
    fill_gaps(Q = 0) %>%
    features(Q, ~ feat_stl(
      .x, 
      s.window = "periodic",
      .period  = 12)
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: create seasonal trend strength facet plot

create_seasonal_trend_strength_facet_plot <- function(dt){
  
  # Define hierarchical order using data.table
  mat_order <- MATHIER[order(names(MATHIER), decreasing = FALSE)]
  cus_order <- CSTHIER[order(names(CSTHIER), decreasing = TRUE)]
  
  # More elegant data.table way using CJ (Cross Join)
  all_combinations <- CJ(
    MAT = mat_order,
    CUS = cus_order,
    sorted = FALSE  # Keep the order we specified
  )[, combination := paste(MAT, CUS, sep = " - ")]  
  
  # Set factor levels
  dt[, combination := factor(
    AGG_LVL, levels = all_combinations$combination)]
  
  # Replace underscores in existing combinations if needed
  dt[, combination := factor(
    gsub("_", " - ", AGG_LVL), 
    levels = gsub("_", " - ", all_combinations$combination)
  )]
  
  # Create the faceted scatter plot
  plot <- 
    ggplot(dt, 
         aes(x = trend_strength, y = seasonal_strength_12)) +
    geom_point(
      fill  = "#38e56d", 
      color = "#38e56d",
      alpha = 0.1,  # Increased from 0.1 for better visibility
      size  = 1.0    # Added size for consistency
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ combination, ncol = 4, nrow = 5) +
    # Force both axes to show 0-1 range
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    # Set consistent tick marks and labels
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),  # Ticks at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.5", "0.75", "1")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),  # Ticks at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.5", "0.75", "1")
    ) +  
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),
      axis.title         = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.text          = element_text(size = 5),  
      strip.text         = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", color = "gray60"),  
      panel.spacing      = unit(0.4, "lines"),  
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),  
      plot.caption       = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = "Time Series Feature Distribution by Material-Customer Hierarchy",
      subtitle = "No notable difference in Trend vs Seasonal Strength",
      x        = "Trend Strength",  
      y        = "Seasonal Strength (12-month)",
      caption  = "distribution of trend vs seasonal strength for different hierarchy combinations"
    )
  
  save_plot(plot, "seasonal_trend_strength_facet_plot" )
  
  return(plot)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: create SBM

create_plot_sbm <- function(
    dt, 
    adi_bound = 5, 
    cv2_bound = 15){
  
  hidden_count <- nrow(dt[ADI > adi_bound | CV2 > cv2_bound])
  total_count  <- nrow(dt)
  pct_shown    <- round((total_count - hidden_count) / total_count * 100, 1)
  
      
  # Calculate global percentages for subtitle
  summary_dt <- dt[, .(N = .N), by = SBC]                          %>%
    .[, Percentage := round(N / sum(N) * 100, 1)]                 %T>% 
    setorder(-Percentage)                                          %>%
    .[, subtitle:= paste0(SBC, "(", Percentage, "%) ")]                             
    
  # Create subtitle with overall percentages
  subtitle_clean <- paste0(
    "Aggregation level: ", paste(dt$MAT_LVL[1], '-', dt$CUS_LVL[1]), "\n",
    paste(summary_dt$subtitle, collapse = " "  ))
  
  plot <- dt %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = ADI, y = CV2)) +
    # Add background rectangles for each quadrant
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.32, ymin = -Inf, ymax = 0.49, 
             fill = SBC_colors['S'], alpha = 0.1) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.32, ymin = 0.49, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = SBC_colors['E'], alpha = 0.1) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 1.32, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = 0.49, 
             fill = SBC_colors['I'], alpha = 0.1) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 1.32, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0.49, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = SBC_colors['L'], alpha = 0.1) +
    # Add text labels in each quadrant
    annotate("text", x = 0.2, y = 0.25, 
             label = "Smooth (S)", 
             color = SBC_colors['S'], 
             size = 6, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.2, y =3.0, 
             label = "Erratic (E)", 
             color = SBC_colors['E'], 
             size = 6, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 2.6, y = 0.25, 
             label = "Intermittent (I)", 
             color = SBC_colors['I'], 
             size = 6, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 2.6, y = 3.0, 
             label = "Lumpy (L)", 
             color = SBC_colors['L'], 
             size = 6, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = SBC), 
      size     = 2, 
      alpha    = 0.3,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0.05, seed = 123)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1.32, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.49, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = SBC_colors,
      labels = c(
        "S" = "Smooth (S)",
        "E" = "Erratic (E)", 
        "I" = "Intermittent (I)",
        "L" = "Lumpy (L)"
      ),
      guide = guide_legend(
        reverse = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(size = 4)  # Larger points in legend only)
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, adi_bound), ylim = c(0, cv2_bound)) +  # Add this line to zoom  
    labs(
      title    = "Syntetos-Boylan Demand Pattern Classification (Zoomed View)",
      subtitle = subtitle_clean,
      x        = "ADI (Average Demand Interval)",
      y        = "CV² (Coefficient of Variation Squared)",
      color    = "SBC",
      caption  = paste0("Syntetos, A.A. & Boylan, J.E. (2005) | ADI = 1.32, CV² = 0.49 \n",
                        "Zoom: ADI 0-5, CV² 0-15 | Showing ", pct_shown, "% of data points (",
                        total_count - hidden_count, "/", total_count, ")")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),  # Changed from 16 to 14
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),  # Changed from 12 to 10
      axis.title         = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),  # Changed from 12 to 11
      axis.text          = element_text(size = 10),  # Kept same
      legend.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),  # Kept same
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 12),  # Kept same
      legend.key.size    = unit(1.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.width   = unit(2.0, "cm"),
      legend.key.height  = unit(1.0, "cm"),      
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.direction   = "horizontal",
      legend.box         = "horizontal",
      legend.margin      = margin(b = 10),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),  # Added to match reference
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      plot.caption       = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")  # Kept same
    )
  
  save_plot(plot, "plot_sbm" )
  
  return(plot)
}
```

#### create plot sbc_by_ts
```{r}
#| label: 'Function to plot SB-Classes distribution by time series length'

create_plot_sbc_by_ts <- 
  function(dt_plot){
    # Calculate percentages and label positions by SLEN
    dt_plot[, total:= sum(N), by = SLEN]                             %>%
      .[, percentage:= N / total * 100]
    
    # Calculate global percentages for reference lines
    summary_dt <- dt_plot[, .(N = .N), by = SBC]                     %>%
      .[, Percentage := round(N / sum(N) * 100, 1)]                 %T>% 
      setorder(-Percentage)                                          %>%
      .[, subtitle:= paste0(SBC, "(", Percentage, "%) ")]                                     
    
    # Determine the stacking order (smallest to largest average)
    actual_sbc_order <-
      summary_dt[, SBC] 
    
    # Create subtitle with overall percentages
    subtitle_clean <- paste0(
      "Stable distribution, excluding boundary-induced variation \n ",
      paste(summary_dt$subtitle, collapse = " "  ))
    
    # CREATE FACTOR LEVELS to control stacking order
    dt_plot[, SBC := factor(SBC, levels = rev(actual_sbc_order))]
    
    # Sort data by SLEN (no need to sort by percentage anymore - factor levels control stacking)
    dt_plot_ordered <- setorder(dt_plot, SLEN)
    
    # Calculate cumulative percentages in the SAME order
    summary_dt_ordered <- summary_dt[match(actual_sbc_order, SBC)]       %>%
      .[, cum_percentage := cumsum(Percentage)]
    
    # Extract cumulative percentages - only the ones we need (not the 100% line)
    cum_percentages <- summary_dt_ordered$cum_percentage
    cum_classes     <- summary_dt_ordered$SBC
    
    # Define colors for each class
    cum_colors   <- SBC_colors[cum_classes]
    
    ap <- 1.0  # Alpha for dashed lines
    lw <- 1.7  # Line width for dashed lines
    # Create  plot
    plot <- ggplot(
      dt_plot_ordered, 
      aes(
        x    = factor(SLEN), 
        y    = percentage, 
        fill = SBC)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", alpha = 0.7) +
      # Add cumulative dashed horizontal lines manually
      {if(length(cum_percentages) >= 1) 
        geom_hline(yintercept = cum_percentages[1], 
                   color      = cum_colors[1], 
                   linetype   = "dashed", 
                   alpha      = ap, 
                   linewidth  = lw)} +
      {if(length(cum_percentages) >= 2) 
        geom_hline(yintercept = cum_percentages[2], 
                   color      = cum_colors[2], 
                   linetype   = "dashed", 
                   alpha      = ap, 
                   linewidth  = lw)} +
      {if(length(cum_percentages) >= 3) 
        geom_hline(yintercept = cum_percentages[3], 
                   color      = cum_colors[3], 
                   linetype   = "dashed", 
                   alpha      = ap, 
                   linewidth  = lw)} +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = SBC_colors,
        labels = c(
          "S" = "Smooth (S)",
          "E" = "Erratic (E)", 
          "I" = "Intermittent (I)",
          "L" = "Lumpy (L)"
        ),
        guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
      ) +
      labs(
        title    = "% Distribution of SB-Classes by time series length",
        subtitle = subtitle_clean,
        x        = "time series length in months",
        y        = "Percentage (%)",
        fill     = "SBC",
        caption  = paste0(
          "SBC requires > 6 months for to be reliable \n"  , 
          "Dashed lines show cumulative global percentages \n",
          "**Note the large % of smooth time series at the right end (> 46 months)**"
        )
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),
        axis.title         = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        legend.title       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        legend.position    = "bottom",
        legend.direction   = "horizontal",
        legend.box         = "horizontal",
        legend.margin      = margin(b = 10),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
      )
    
    save_plot(plot, "plot_sbc_by_ts" )
    
    return(plot)
  }
```

#### create_class_pivot
```{r}
#| label: 'Create table with analysis of SBC data'

# Enhanced flexible function with total_column parameter
create_class_pivot <- function(
    dt, 
    type    = "P",
    X_order = NULL,  # Custom X-axis order
    Y_order = NULL,  # Custom Y-axis order
    V_order = c('S', 'I', 'E', 'L'),
    X = 'XYZ', 
    Y = 'ABC',
    V = 'SBC',
    total_column = NULL  # NEW: Column to use for totals instead of count
)
{
  
  # Validate inputs
  if (!type %in% c("P", "C")) {
    stop("type must be either 'P' (percentage) or 'C' (count)")
  }
  
  required_cols <- c(Y, X, V)
  if (!is.null(total_column)) {
    required_cols <- c(required_cols, total_column)
  }
  
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(dt))) {
    stop(paste("Columns", paste(required_cols, collapse = ", "), "must exist in the data.table"))
  }
  
  # Get unique values and set default orders if not provided
  unique_Y <- unique(dt[[Y]])
  unique_X <- unique(dt[[X]])
  unique_V <- unique(dt[[V]])
  
  # Set default orders if not provided
  if (is.null(Y_order)) {
    Y_order <- sort(unique_Y)
  }
  if (is.null(X_order)) {
    X_order <- sort(unique_X)
  }
  
  # Validate orders
  if (!all(Y_order %in% unique_Y)) {
    missing_Y <- Y_order[!Y_order %in% unique_Y]
    warning(paste("Y_order contains values not in data:", paste(missing_Y, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  if (!all(X_order %in% unique_X)) {
    missing_X <- X_order[!X_order %in% unique_X]
    warning(paste("X_order contains values not in data:", paste(missing_X, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  if (!all(V_order %in% unique_V)) {
    missing_V <- V_order[!V_order %in% unique_V]
    warning(paste("order contains values not in data:", paste(missing_V, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Calculate counts/totals and percentages for each Y-X combination
  if (is.null(total_column)) {
    # Original behavior: use count (.N)
    summary_dt <- dt[, .N, by = c(Y, X, V)]
    setnames(summary_dt, c(Y, X, V), c("Y_col", "X_col", "V_col"))
    summary_dt[, total := sum(N), by = .(Y_col, X_col)]
    summary_dt[, percentage := round(N / total * 100, 1)]
    value_col_name <- "N"
  } else {
    # New behavior: use specified column for totals
    summary_dt <- dt[, .(total_value = sum(get(total_column), na.rm = TRUE)), by = c(Y, X, V)]
    setnames(summary_dt, c(Y, X, V), c("Y_col", "X_col", "V_col"))
    summary_dt[, total := sum(total_value), by = .(Y_col, X_col)]
    summary_dt[, percentage := round(total_value / total * 100, 1)]
    value_col_name <- "total_value"
  }
  
  # Create the compact format based on type
  compact_dt <- summary_dt[, {
    # Ensure all V categories are present, fill missing with 0
    all_values <- data.table(V_col = V_order)
    
    if (type == "P") {
      # Percentage format
      current <- .SD[, .(V_col, value = percentage)]
      merged <- merge(all_values, current, by = "V_col", all.x = TRUE)
      merged[is.na(value), value := 0]
      
      # Fix: Extract the match operation outside the data.table context
      order_indices <- match(merged$V_col, V_order)
      merged <- merged[order(order_indices)]
      
      paste0("(", paste(merged$value, "%", sep = "", collapse = ", "), ")")
      
    } else {
      # Count format - use the appropriate value column
      if (is.null(total_column)) {
        current <- .SD[, .(V_col, value = N)]
      } else {
        current <- .SD[, .(V_col, value = total_value)]
      }
      merged <- merge(all_values, current, by = "V_col", all.x = TRUE)
      merged[is.na(value), value := 0]
      
      # Fix: Extract the match operation outside the data.table context  
      order_indices <- match(merged$V_col, V_order)
      merged <- merged[order(order_indices)]
      
      paste0("(", paste(merged$value, collapse = ", "), ")")
    }
  }, by = .(Y_col, X_col)]
  
  # Reshape to matrix format
  result_table <- dcast(compact_dt, Y_col ~ X_col, value.var = "V1", 
                        fill = if(type == "P") 
                          paste0("(", paste(rep("0%", length(V_order)), collapse = ", "), ")") else 
                            paste0("(", paste(rep("0", length(V_order)), collapse = ", "), ")"))
  
  # Rename columns back to original names
  setnames(result_table, "Y_col", Y)
  
  # Apply custom ordering to Y-axis (rows)
  if (Y %in% names(result_table)) {
    # Create factor with custom order for Y
    result_table[[Y]] <- factor(result_table[[Y]], levels = Y_order)
    setorderv(result_table, Y)
    # Convert back to character to avoid factor display issues
    result_table[[Y]] <- as.character(result_table[[Y]])
  }
  
  # Apply custom ordering to X-axis (columns)
  # Reorder columns based on X_order
  existing_X_cols <- intersect(X_order, names(result_table)[-1])  # Exclude Y column
  final_col_order <- c(Y, existing_X_cols)
  
  # Add any missing columns that might exist but weren't in X_order
  missing_cols <- setdiff(names(result_table), final_col_order)
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    final_col_order <- c(final_col_order, missing_cols)
  }
  
  result_table <- result_table[, ..final_col_order]
  
  return(result_table)
}
```

#### summarize_sbc
```{r}
# Simple summary function for SBC percentages
summarize_sbc <- function(
    dt, 
    order        = c('S', 'I', 'E', 'L'), 
    total_column = NULL
) {
  
  # Validate input
  if (!"SBC" %in% names(dt)) {
    stop("Column 'SBC' must exist in the data.table")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(total_column) && !total_column %in% names(dt)) {
    stop(paste("Column", total_column, "must exist in the data.table"))
  }
  
  # Calculate percentages
  if (is.null(total_column)) {
    # Count-based percentages
    summary_dt <- dt[, .N, by = SBC]
    summary_dt[, percentage := round(N / sum(N) * 100, 0)]
  } else {
    # Value-based percentages using total_column
    summary_dt <- dt[, .(total_value = sum(get(total_column), na.rm = TRUE)), by = SBC]
    summary_dt[, percentage := round(total_value / sum(total_value) * 100, 0)]
  }
  
  # Ensure all SBC categories are present
  all_sbc <- data.table(SBC = order)
  merged <- merge(all_sbc, summary_dt, by = "SBC", all.x = TRUE)
  merged[is.na(percentage), percentage := 0]
  
  # Order according to specified order
  order_indices <- match(merged$SBC, order)
  merged <- merged[order(order_indices)]
  
  # Create output string
  result <- data.table(
    AGG_LVL = dt$AGG_LVL[1],
    MAT_LVL = dt$MAT_LVL[1],
    CUS_LVL = dt$CUS_LVL[1],
    SBCSIEL = paste0(
      "(", paste(merged$percentage, "%", sep = "", 
                 collapse = ", "), ")"
    )
  )
  
  return(result)
}

```
``

## Analyse ABC/XYZ and SBC

```{r}
#| label: Analysis of SBC data
#| eval: false

# add YEAR and CALMONTH
dtANA_00 <- copy(dtSLS_CM) %>%
  .[CM %between% c(ymd("2024-01-01"), ymd("2024-12-01"))] %>%
  .[, `:=` (
    CLASS_SORG   = calc_ABC(
      dt = .,
      agg_lvl    = c("SALESORG"),
      thresholds = c(A = 0.8, B = 0.95),
      value_col  = "Q"
    ),
    CLASS_PLNT   = calc_ABC(
      dt = .,
      agg_lvl    = c("PLANT"),
      thresholds = c(A = 0.8, B = 0.95),
      value_col  = "Q"
    ),
    CLASS_MAT   = calc_ABC(
      dt = .,
      agg_lvl    = c("MATERIAL"),
      thresholds = c(A = 0.8, B = 0.95),
      value_col  = "Q"
    ),
    CLASS_MTCS   = calc_ABC(
      dt = .,
      agg_lvl    = c("MATERIAL", "CUSTOMER"),
      thresholds = c(A = 0.8, B = 0.95),
      value_col  = "Q"
    )       
  )] 

dtANA_01 <- 
  dtCLS[, 
        .(MATERIAL, CUSTOMER, PLANT, SALESORG, SLEN) ]      %>%
  .[dtANA_00, on = .(MATERIAL, CUSTOMER, PLANT, SALESORG)] 

dtABC_SORG <- 
  dtANA_00[, .(N = .N, Q = sum(Q)), 
           by = .(SALESORG, CLASS_SORG)]         %>%
  .[, P:= 100 * Q/sum(Q)]                       %T>% 
  setorder(CLASS_SORG, -P)

dtABC_PLNT <- 
  dtANA_00[, .(N = .N, Q = sum(Q)), 
           by = .(PLANT, CLASS_PLNT)]            %>%
  .[, P:= 100 * Q/sum(Q)]                       %T>%
  setorder(CLASS_PLNT, -P)

dtABC_MAT <- 
  dtANA_00[PLANT == 'FR30', .(N = .N, Q = sum(Q)), 
           by = .(MATERIAL, CLASS_MAT)]          %>%
  .[, P:= 100 * Q/sum(Q)]                       %T>%
  setorder(CLASS_MAT, -P)

dtABC_SLEN <- 
  dtANA_01[, .(N = .N, Q = sum(Q)), 
           by = .(SLEN, CLASS_MTCS)]             %>%
  .[, p:= 100 * Q/sum(Q), by = .(SLEN)]         %T>%
  .[, P:= 100 * Q/sum(Q)]                       %T>%
  setorder(-P)

# only time series with a full year in 2024 
# 2401 articles for all Plants
# 643 for FR30

dtABC_MCSL <- 
  dtANA_00[, .(N = .N, Q = sum(Q)), 
           by = .(SLEN, CLASS_MCSL)]                    %>%
  .[, P:= 100 * Q/sum(Q)]                              %T>%
  setorder(CLASS_MCSL, -P)

# Number of time series per LEN/CLASS
dtANA_10 <- dtANA_00 %>%
  .[, .(
    MAT_CNT = uniqueN(MATERIAL),
    CST_CNT = uniqueN(CUSTOMER),
    CMP_CNT = .N
  ), by = .(SLEN, SBC)] 

dtANA_20 <- dtANA_10 %>%
  .[, POG := 100 * CMP_CNT / sum(CMP_CNT), 
    by = SLEN] %>%
  .[, POT:= 100 * CMP_CNT/ sum(CMP_CNT)
  ]

dtANA_20_wide <- dtANA_20 %>%
  dcast(
    SLEN ~ SBC, 
    value.var = c("POT", "CMP_CNT"), 
    fill = 0
  ) 

```

## Complete workflow

### Load and prepare data 

```{r}
#| label: Load and prepare data  
 
# 1. Get sales per Month
dtSLS_DAY <- get_sales_per_day()  
dtSLS_CM  <- get_sales_per_month(dtSLS_DAY)

fwrite(
  data.table(
    Data_Set = c("Sales/Day"    , "Sales/Month"),
    Records  = c(nrow(dtSLS_DAY), nrow(dtSLS_CM))
  ), 
  file = file.path(PDATA, "SLS_RECORDS.csv"), 
  row.names = FALSE
)


# 2.  Create Matrix with aggregations per Material and Customer
if(flgCache == TRUE){
  lstSLS <- readRDS(file.path(PDATA, "lstSLS.rds"))
} else {
  lstSLS <- aggregate_mc_combinations_flexible(
    dtSLS_CM,
    m_cols       = MATHIER,
    c_cols       = CSTHIER,
    agg_function = sum
  )
}

# 3. determine Class per Material and Customer
if(flgCache == TRUE){
  lstCLS <- readRDS(file.path(PDATA, "lstCLS.rds"))
} else {
  lstCLS <- purrr::map(
    .x = lstSLS, 
    .f = create_ts_classifications, 
    MAT_LEVEL  = 'M_value', 
    CUST_LEVEL = 'C_value'
  )
}

dtCLS <- rbindlist(
  lstCLS, 
  use.names = TRUE, 
  fill = TRUE
) %T>% 
  save_data(fn = "dtCLS")

#4. Join and filter time series with classification data
target_names <- intersect(names(lstCLS), names(lstSLS))

if(flgCache == TRUE){
  lstSCP <- readRDS(file.path(PDATA, "lstSCP.rds"))
} else {
  lstSCP <- imap(
    lstCLS[target_names],  # Subset to only the names you want
    function(cls_data, name) {
      # Explicit selection by name
      sls_data <- lstSLS[[name]]
      
      # Safety check
      if (is.null(sls_data)) {
        stop(paste("No matching sales data found for:", name))
      }
      
      message(paste0(
        "Joining time series >= 12 months with classification data for ",
        paste0(
          str_pad(cls_data$MAT_LVL[1], 8, "right", " "), " - ",
          str_pad(cls_data$CUS_LVL[1], 8, "right", " ")), "..."
      ))
      
      result <- 
        cls_data[SLEN >= 12, !"Q"] %>%
        .[sls_data, on = .(
          M_value, C_value, 
          PLANT, SALESORG), nomatch = 0]
      
      return(result)
    }
  )
}
dtSCP <- rbindlist(lstSCP)
```

- `r nrow(dtSLS_DAY)` time series with sales per day`  
- `r nrow(dtSLS_CM )` time series with sales per month`

```{r}
} else {
  dtFTS <- purrr::map(
    .x = lstSCP, 
    .f = calculate_features_stl
  ) %>%
    rbindlist() %T>%

}

} else {
  dtAUG <- 
    dtFTS[dtCLS, on = .(
      SALESORG, PLANT, AGG_LVL, M_value, C_value
    ), nomatch = 0] %T>%
    save_data(fn = "dtAUG_ALL")
}

# 6. Plot Seasonal & Trend strength facets
create_seasonal_trend_strength_facet_plot(dtFTS)
```

```{r}
  .[!(is.na(seasonal_strength_12) | is.na(trend_strength)),

      seasonal_strength_12, trend_strength)
  ] %>% 
  setorder(-seasonal_strength_12, -trend_strength)  %>% 
  .[, .SD[1], by = .(AGG_LVL)]  %>%
  .[dtSCP[, .(AGG_LVL, M_value, C_value, PLANT, SALESORG, CM, Q)],
    on = .(AGG_LVL, M_value, C_value, PLANT, SALESORG), nomatch = 0] 

create_examples_facet_plot(dtEXP) %>%
```
